gatewayProbePaths.note: EXACT-match routes the gateway sends DIRECTLY to the application service, bypassing authentication. These are defined by the gateway, not declared by the application — a different concept from the publicPrefix below, which is where an app puts its OWN public routes.
gatewayProbePaths.match: exact — /health is a probe path, /health/detail is not
gatewayProbePaths.appMustNotProtectThem: Probes, readiness/liveness checks, and ops tooling depend on these answering without a session. An app that requires auth on them breaks its own deployment. Do NOT move them under /dangerously-skip-login/ and do NOT treat an unauthenticated /health or /api/health at the root as a violation — the gateway routes them that way by design.
gatewayProbePaths.xUserIdAbsent: No X-User-Id is forwarded on these paths. Never read identity in a probe handler.
gatewayProbePaths.nonDefaultPaths: If the app's probe paths differ from these four, declare them in .platform/observability.yaml rather than inventing another public scheme.
gatewayProbePaths.extraBypasses: Additional login bypasses (for example /dangerously-skip-login) are declared in .platform/routing.yaml when platform policy enables them.

reservedPrefixes.rule: Do not define app routes under reserved prefixes. The gateway owns them.

loginRequired.description: Every path requires a valid login unless under the public prefix or among the gateway probe paths. Anonymous browsers get 302 to /auth/ui/login?redirect=<path>; API requests get 401.
loginRequired.guarantee: On normal paths, if the request reaches the app, X-User-Id is present.

publicPrefix.policy: Only prefix open to anonymous visitors
publicPrefix.notes: Serve public routes under this exact path. X-User-Id is set only if the visitor happens to be logged in. Keep public surface small. Name is deliberate — opting out of login must be conscious.

suggestedLayout./health, /api/health, /version, /api/ver: Gateway probe paths — unauthenticated by gateway design, exact match, served by the app
suggestedLayout./dangerously-skip-login/: The app's own public pages (anonymous OK)

logoutComplete.notes: Clears gateway session; also CAS Single Logout when gateway uses CAS

logoutCookieOnly.notes: Clears cookie only — no CAS SLO
